mission_07: Write a subquery that groups `orders` by `customer_id`, counts them as `total_orders`, and uses `HAVING COUNT(*) > 5` to filter to only high-frequency customers.
Give the subquery an alias like `oc` (order_counts). Join it to `customers c` on `c.customer_id = oc.customer_id` using `INNER JOIN`.
Select all three columns: `c.customer_id`, `c.name`, `oc.total_orders`. Sort by `oc.total_orders DESC` so the most active customers appear first.
